prompt:
﻿# genui_gen_v4_compact

You are a GenUICraft generator.
Convert the RESPONSE text into valid GenUICraft v0.9 server-to-client messages.

RESPONSE:
Project Status Report: Website Redesign

Date: 2024-03-01

Summary:
The 'Website Redesign' project is currently facing significant challenges. While UI Mockups are complete, the critical Backend API development is only 60% complete, directly blocking QA Testing. Content Migration has not yet started.

Task Status Overview:
This table details the current state of each project task.

Task: UI Mockups | Status: Completed | Progress: 100%
Task: Backend API | Status: In Progress | Progress: 60%
Task: Content Migration | Status: Not Started | Progress: 0%
Task: QA Testing | Status: Blocked by Backend | Progress: 0%

Project Health Status:
At Risk
The project is at risk due to key dependencies not being met and a major component still in progress. The inability to start QA Testing and Content Migration significantly impacts the project timeline.

Primary Bottleneck:
Backend API Development
The Backend API development is the primary bottleneck. Its incomplete status (60%) is directly blocking the QA Testing phase. Until the Backend API is finalized, further progress on testing and potentially other dependent tasks like Content Migration cannot proceed efficiently.

Icons:
- Completed: https://example.com/icons/checkmark.png
- In Progress: https://example.com/icons/gear.png
- Not Started: https://example.com/icons/clock.png
- Blocked: https://example.com/icons/stop_sign.png

Quick Actions:
[Button: Update Backend API Status] https://example.com/project/websiteredesign/backend_status_update
[Button: Review Backend API Development Plan] https://example.com/project/websiteredesign/backend_plan
[Button: Discuss Content Migration Readiness] https://example.com/project/websiteredesign/content_migration_planning

Output contract:
- Output ONLY a JSON array (no markdown, no prose).
- Each array item must be one v0.9 message object.
- Allowed message types only: `createSurface`, `updateComponents`, `updateDataModel`, `deleteSurface`.
- Add `createSurface` before any updates.
- `createSurface.catalogId` must be `https://genui.local/specification/v0_9/standard_catalog.json`.
- Include exactly one `updateComponents` message with a complete component set.
- In that set, include exactly one component with `id: "root"` as tree root.
- Component ids must be unique; all child references must resolve.
- Use only catalog-supported components and properties.

Component guidance:
- Prefer structured UI over text dumps.
- Use `Card`, `Row`, `Column`, `List`, `Tabs`, `Divider`, `Button` where appropriate.
- Convert action-like links/"Quick Actions" to `Button` with `action.functionCall.call = "openUrl"`.
- Preserve key content (assumptions, options, comparisons, totals, sources) without hallucination.
- If dynamic rows are useful, use `updateDataModel` + template children binding.

Assets and URLs:
- For media, use only local asset paths that start with `/`.
- Never output remote image/icon URLs.
- For web actions, `openUrl` targets may be remote URLs.

Validation reminders:
- `version` must be `"v0.9"` on every message.
- `updateComponents.components` must be a non-empty array.
- Keep JSON strictly valid.
